metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 600 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: Pairs carry no labels; wrongness is checked against VeriEQL's published counterexamples and a second random search. 14 of the 64 pairs differ between our file and the published outcomes file and were not audited. Developed against these pairs (tuned on test).
